manifest.name: dsh-popup-cards
manifest.description: Topmost DSH-styled Windows cards for DeepSeek Harness approvals, questions and finished runs — click to jump back to the app that started the session (DSH by default), close with the × button, or let it close when you return.
manifest.author: Leo <1958923515@qq.com> (https://github.com/Leo1958923515)

Topmost Windows cards that tell you when DeepSeek Harness needs you — while you are looking at another app.

When a tool asks for permission, the model asks a question, a plan waits for review, or a run finishes, a small card appears in the bottom-right corner of your screen. It looks like the DeepSeek Harness client (dark panel, 12 px radius), stays until you deal with it, and never blocks the agent turn.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness already shows approvals and questions in its own window. That is useless when you are editing code in another app, reading a browser tab, or waiting for a long build. This plugin brings that moment to your desktop with a card that survives window switching, and lets you jump straight back:

- **Click the card** → the app that started the session comes to the front (DSH by default), the card closes.
- **Click the × in the top-right corner** → the card closes, and DSH stays where it is.
- **Switch back to DSH yourself** → the card notices and closes itself.
- **Already looking at DSH** → nothing pops up (the in-app prompt is enough).
The card itself only carries two facts, by design: **which task** and **what kind of confirmation** it is. No message bodies, no tool arguments, no code.

Requirements: Windows 10/11, PowerShell 5.1 (bundled with Windows), DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`.

**Desktop app (recommended).** Settings → Plugins → Install, and paste the repository URL:

```
https://github.com/Leo1958923515/dsh-popup-cards
```

**Command line.** From the profile directory (the desktop profile is managed by the app):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Leo1958923515/dsh-popup-cards
```

**Local checkout.**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:\path\to\dsh-popup-cards
```

The plugin loads immediately after installation — DSH hot-reloads profile patch files, so no restart is needed.

> Naming: the repository and the plugin package are both `dsh-popup-cards`, and the package name matches `name:` in `cordis.patch.yml`. Install from the URL above; the directory name of a local checkout does not matter.
> Windows only. On other platforms the plugin loads but silently skips popups (a warning is written to the DSH log).

Everything is optional. Add overrides to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — the object replaces the defaults, so repeat any key you still want:

```yaml
- id: popup-notify
  config:
    sound: true
    durationMs: 8000

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | Pop when a tool waits for permission. |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | Pop when the model asks a question or submits a plan for review. |
| `notifyOnComplete` | `true` | Pop when a root agent goes from `running` to `idle`. |
| `ignoreSubagents` | `true` | Stay quiet for sub-agents, background delegations and workflow workers. |
| `skipWhenDSHFocused` | `true` | Skip the card while DSH (or the client that started the session) is in the foreground. |
| `dshWindowTitleMarker` | `— DeepSeek Harness` | Title fallback: a matching window title also counts as DSH. |
| `attributeByClient` | `true` | Remember which client started each session (foreground process name) and stay quiet while it is in front. |
| `clientProcesses` | `[]` | Client process names that take part in attribution, e.g. `['Obsidian.exe']`; DSH itself must not be listed. |
| `activateDSHOnClick` | `true` | Clicking the card brings the session's client to the front before closing. |
| `autoCloseOnDSHFocus` | `true` | Close the card when you return to the session's client (or DSH) on your own. |
| `foregroundPollMs` | `400` | Foreground check i

```yaml
- id: popup-notify
  config:
    testOnStart: true
```

Reload the profile and one card appears immediately. The self-test card skips the foreground suppression and never auto-closes, so you can inspect it; click it (or the ×) to dismiss. Set `testOnStart: false` to stop.

The card is a borderless, always-on-top WPF window hosted by a short-lived `powershell.exe` (hidden, `-NonInteractive`, script passed via `-EncodedCommand`). It is positioned 24 px above the bottom-right corner of the primary display's work area, so it never covers the taskbar, and it fades in over 160 ms.

- **One card at a time.** Later notifications queue; the next one opens when the current one closes.
- **No focus stealing.** The window does not activate itself.
- **Detached process.** A card lives in its own process, so a long approval wait never blocks a turn. The plugin only tracks the process exit to drain the queue.
- **Fail-open.** If the foreground check or the Win32 helper fails to compile, the card still shows; a broken detector never eats a notification.
- **Closing is never "answering".** Dismissing a card does not approve anything — you still answer in DSH. Cards are a reminder, not a remote control.

Foreground detection is primarily **process based**, with the window title only as a fallback: every time you send a message (root agent enters `running`) the plugin records the foreground window's process name against that session, and the card compares `DeepSeek Harness.exe` first, then that session's client process (e.g. `Obsidian.exe`). A title match still suppresses the card when the process name cannot be read.

| Event | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| `approval/request` (waterfall) | A tool needs your approval. Registered with `prepend` and always calls `next()`, so the built-in bridge still answers it. |
| `tools/pre-execute` (waterfall) | `ask_user_question` → "question", `exit_plan_mode` → "plan review". Always calls `next()`, so the tool still runs. |
| `agent/status` | `running → idle` for a root agent → "run finished"; the `running` edge also records the session's client attribution. |
The first line of the card is the session title (`ctx.get('sessionTitle')`), falling back to the working-directory name, then to the first 8 characters of the session id.

- Windows 10 or 11.
- PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`), which ships with Windows.
- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`.
- No npm dependencies, no native modules, no build step, no network access.

- **Windows only.** macOS/Linux fall back to "no popup" (logged once per spawn).
- **Not actionable.** The card cannot approve or reject; it only tells you something is waiting.
- **Attribution is a heuristic.** The session's client is inferred from the foreground process at the moment you send a message; it is sampled once, on the root agent's `running` edge. Switching windows while the run is in progress does not change it, but messages forwarded from a browser (or sent while the foreground is something else) fall back to the DSH-only rule — such an unattributed card stays quiet while the DSH window is in front, even if the run was started elsewhere. `dshWindowTitleMarker` remains a title fallback.
- **Not a notification centre.** No history, no badge, no per-type styling: that is deliberate, so the card stays a glanceable prompt.
- **PowerShell startup.** Creating a card costs roughly the cold-start of `Add-Type`/WPF (a few hundred milliseconds); cards are serialized, so bursts queue instead of racing.

```sh
npm test          # node --test: pure functions + config/metadata checks
npm run pack:check
```

The test suite runs without Windows: it asserts the generated PowerShell script contains the expected gates and handlers, and checks locale/manifest metadata. Actually rendering a card needs Windows + PowerShell.

Report bugs: <https://github.com/Leo1958923515/dsh-popup-cards/issues>.

在其它软件界面里也能收到 DeepSeek Harness 的提醒：需要权限、模型提问、计划待审、任务完成时，屏幕右下角弹出一张置顶卡片。

卡片长成 DSH 客户端的样子（深色面板、12px 圆角），不挡住你的工作，也不会卡住 agent 回合。它只显示两件事：**哪个任务**、**是哪种待确认**。

[English](README.md)

DSH 本来就会在自己的窗口里提示审批和提问——但那时你正在别的软件里写代码、看网页、等构建，根本看不到。这个插件把「该你了」这件事搬到桌面上，并且给了一条最快的回去的路：

- **点卡片任意处** → 发起该会话的应用切到最前（默认是 DSH），卡片关闭。
- **点右上角 ×** → 只关卡片，不切回 DSH。
- **自己切回 DSH** → 卡片发现你已经回来了，自动关闭。
- **本来就在 DSH 里** → 不弹（应用内提示已经够了）。

卡片上不出现消息正文、工具参数或代码，只有任务名和待确认类型。

环境：Windows 10/11、系统自带 PowerShell 5.1、DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。

**桌面端（推荐）**：设置 → 插件 → 安装，粘贴仓库地址：

```
https://github.com/Leo1958923515/dsh-popup-cards
```

**命令行**（desktop profile 由桌面端管理）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Leo1958923515/dsh-popup-cards
```

**本地目录**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:\path\to\dsh-popup-cards
```

装完即生效：DSH 会热加载 profile 的 patch 文件，不用重启。

> 命名说明：仓库与插件包名都是 `dsh-popup-cards`，包名与 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `name:` 一致。按上面的地址安装即可；本地目录叫什么不影响加载。

> 仅支持 Windows。其它平台插件会正常加载，但弹窗会被跳过（DSH 日志里有一条警告）。

全部可选。覆盖项写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里——config 是整体替换的，想保留默认值的键要一起写上：

```yaml
- id: popup-notify
  config:
    sound: true
    durationMs: 8000

| 配置项 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | 工具等待权限确认时弹。 |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | 模型提问、或提交计划待审阅时弹。 |
| `notifyOnComplete` | `true` | 根 agent 从 `running` 落到 `idle` 时弹。 |
| `ignoreSubagents` | `true` | 子 agent、后台委派、workflow worker 不弹。 |
| `skipWhenDSHFocused` | `true` | 前台是 DSH（桌面端或本会话的发起客户端）时不弹。 |
| `dshWindowTitleMarker` | `— DeepSeek Harness` | 标题兜底：窗口标题里出现这段文字也认为是 DSH。 |
| `attributeByClient` | `true` | 记录每个会话是从哪个客户端发起的（前台进程名），该客户端在前台时静音。 |
| `clientProcesses` | `[]` | 参与归属的客户端进程名，例如 `['Obsidian.exe']`；DSH 自己不用填。 |
| `activateDSHOnClick` | `true` | 点卡片先把发起会话的客户端切到前台，再关卡片。 |
| `autoCloseOnDSHFocus` | `true` | 你切回发起会话的客户端（或 DSH）时，卡片自动关。 |
| `foregroundPollMs` | `400` | 卡片打开期间检测前台的间隔（毫秒，夹在 100–2000）。 |
| `sound` | `false` | 弹窗时播放系统提示音。 |
| `durationMs` | `0` | N 毫秒后自动关闭；`0` 表示常驻，点一下才关。 |
| `hintText` | `点击回到 DSH` | 第三行小字；设为 `''` 隐藏。 |
| `completeCooldownMs` | `10000` | 同一会话两次「任务完成」之间的最小间隔。 |
| `title` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 自检卡片显示的任务名。 |
| `testOnStart` | `false` | 加载时立刻弹一张，用来确认 PowerShell 通路可用。 |
| `traceFile` | `''` | 把诊断日志（为什么弹、为什么跳过、什么时候关）追加到这个文件。 |

```yaml
- id: popup-notify
  config:
    testOnStart: true
```

重载后立刻弹一张。自检卡片跳过前台抑制、也不会自动关闭，方便你看样式；点卡片或点 × 关闭。改回 `false` 即不再自检。

卡片是一个无边框、置顶的 WPF 窗口，宿主是一个短命的 `powershell.exe`（隐藏窗口、`-NonInteractive`、脚本经 `-EncodedCommand` 传入）。它贴在主屏工作区右下角上方 24px，不压任务栏，160ms 淡入。

- **同一时刻只有一张卡片**，后面的排队，当前这张关掉再弹下一张。
- **不抢焦点**，卡片自己不激活。
- **独立进程**：挂着的审批不会卡住回合；插件只监听进程退出，用来推进队列。
- **失败开放**：前台判断或 Win32 助手编译失败时照常弹卡片，检测坏了也不会吞掉提醒。
- **关掉卡片 ≠ 同意**：卡片只是提醒，审批和回答仍然要在 DSH 里完成。

前台判断以**进程名**为主、窗口标题为辅：你每发一条消息（根 agent 进入 `running`），插件记一次此刻前台窗口的进程名，和这个会话绑定；之后卡片进程先比 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`，再比这个会话的客户端进程（如 `Obsidian.exe`），命中任意一个就不弹。标题匹配只作为兜底，用于拿不到进程名的极端情况。

插件监听三个 Cordis 事件，不替换 DSH 自带的界面：

| 事件 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `approval/request`（waterfall） | 工具等待审批。用 `prepend` 注册并始终 `next()`，内置审批桥照常作答。 |
| `tools/pre-execute`（waterfall） | `ask_user_question` → 提问；`exit_plan_mode` → 计划确认。始终 `next()`，工具照常执行。 |
| `agent/status` | 根 agent `running → idle` → 任务完成；同一事件在 `running` 起点记录一次客户端归属。 |

卡片第一行取会话标题（`ctx.get('sessionTitle')`），取不到退到工作目录名，再退到会话 id 前 8 位。

- Windows 10 / 11。
- PowerShell 5.1（`powershell.exe`，系统自带）。
- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。
- 没有任何 npm 依赖、原生模块、构建步骤，也不联网。

- **只支持 Windows**：其它平台不弹（每次触发记一条日志）。
- **不能替你操作**：卡片无法批准/拒绝，只能告诉你「有东西在等」。
- **归属是启发式判断**：会话归属靠「发消息那一刻的前台进程」推断，只在根 agent `running` 时采样一次。你在等待期间切窗口不会改归属；但如果消息是在浏览器里从第三方转发进来的、或前台恰好是别的东西，归属会落到 DSH 或空，此时退回「DSH 前台才静音」的旧规则——换句话说，归属没记上的卡片，在 DSH 窗口前台时会被静音，哪怕这次任务是别的软件发起的。窗口标题（`dshWindowTitleMarker`）只做兜底。
- **不是通知中心**：没有历史、角标、分类样式——刻意保持「扫一眼就懂」。
- **PowerShell 冷启动**：出一张卡要付一次 `Add-Type`/WPF 的启动成本（几百毫秒），所以卡片是串行的，密集提醒会排队而不是并发抢屏。

```sh
npm test          # node --test：纯函数 + 配置/元数据检查
npm run pack:check
```

测试不需要 Windows：断言生成的 PowerShell 脚本包含应有的门禁与处理器，并校验 locale/manifest；真正渲染卡片需要 Windows + PowerShell。
